checklist.statement: The schema defines every top-level type B.1 lists, and enforces for each the property constraints B.2 gives.
If the implementation publishes no such schema, the outcome is `NOT_APPLICABLE` (1.2).

notes: Inspection of published slice-11 README, Conformance Statement, and OPENAPI.json. README expressly states OpenAPI is published as API documentation, not an AQEF JSON Schema artifact. Conformance Statement repeats that distinction in its serialization/schema declaration; the OpenAPI info.description also says it is not an AQEF JSON Schema artifact. Appendix B 0.41.5 binds B.1/B.2 schema-artifact MUSTs only when such an artifact is published, while implementation configuration validation remains independently mandatory. Item 1 is not evaluated because no qualifying artifact is offered. No signed reviewer attestation is asserted by this unsigned draft; signature_ref must be added by authorized signer.
